Why you should apply

Dive into Berlin’s startup ecosystem

Whether you’re just starting out or looking to take your venture to the next level, at START Berlin you dive deep into a vibrant ecosystem of innovation, collaboration and growth. Explore our network, connect with industry experts and learn from peers to sharpen your skills and bring your ideas to life.

  • A network of talented members and potential co-founders
  • Direct contact with, and insights into, the most successful startups in Berlin
  • Contact to investors, mentors, startups and industry experts
  • Workshops with industry experts on topics such as legal, sales and entrepreneurship
  • Access to the international START network with partners across Europe and Latin America
  • An extensive network of START Berlin partners and alumni

To provide these benefits and keep the organisation financially sustainable, active members pay a membership fee of €40 per semester.

Who we are looking for

Is this you?

We look forward to your application if:

  • You are enrolled at a university
  • You have a burning passion for entrepreneurship
  • You want to become a founder, get into venture capital, meet prospective co-founders or learn more about the ecosystem
  • You commit to being an active member of our community for one entire year
  • You are based in Berlin for at least the next 6 months

Application process

Your path to START Berlin

  1. 01

    Apply

    Complete a short application questionnaire and upload your CV. You will receive an email confirming that we have received your application.

  2. 02

    Interview

    After an initial screening of the written applications, selected candidates are invited to a short interview with START members.

  3. 03

    Onboarding

    Your first event as an official STARTie. You meet the whole team and get to know each other. Onboarding is mandatory for new members.

We share the dates for interviews and onboarding with each application round. Please block the onboarding in your calendar as soon as you know it, and we strongly encourage you to join the network trip as well.

Want to get to know us?

Meet us in person

Around every application round we host online and in-person info events. Drop by, ask your questions and meet current members before you apply.

About START Berlin

Our departments

Every member is part of a department. Together they drive the organisation’s success and its impact on the Berlin startup ecosystem.

Events

Plans and runs all START Berlin events, from workshops to conferences and seminars, creating valuable experiences for attendees and partners.

Growth

Owns promotion and branding: growth strategy, marketing materials and our social media channels.

Operations & Digital

Runs the internal engine: our website, Slack, Notion and Google Drive, plus the workflows and databases for members, startups and VCs.

Community

Recruits, retains and develops the team. Runs interviews, supports personal development and organises community events.

Partnerships

Finds, negotiates and manages partnerships with organisations, institutions and businesses for long-lasting impact.
